patch_description: Structural redesign: instead of returning raw random points, the program is organized into small pipeline stages — (1) a seeded multi-restart generator producing candidate initial point sets, (2) a force-directed refinement loop on the unit sphere that pushes apart close pairs using a soft-min gradient, and (3) a selection stage that scores each candidate config directly with the evaluator's metric (dmin/dmax)² and keeps the best. This modular data flow (generate → refine → score → select) robustly finds a near-optimal spherical arrangement of 14 points, dramatically raising the min/max distance ratio while remaining fast and reproducible via fixed seeds.
